messages:
alexa: quick heads-up — StratusX (enterprise) wants to POC StratusX-XL q8 variant in Dedicated. They asked about catalog availability, KMS/EKM support, and delta pricing. can we triage?

mike_s: who at StratusX is the contact? any sample payloads?

alexa: cathy@stratusx.com. They're testing long-form summarization + embeddings. smallish tokens per request but long context retention via KV cache.

rajiv: q8 means 8-bit quant; need to confirm KV-cache sharding compatibility. I can run a variant compatibility scan.

elaine: +1. Also check compilation/kernel support on A100-80GB Dedicated — we saw regressions with q8 on older kernels.

rajiv: running local check now. command:
```
ri variant-check --model stratusx-xl --variant q8 --target a100-80 --check kv-cache,kernel
```

infra-bot: automated scan started for stratusx-xl:q8 on a100-80. job id: jb_84321. ETA ~8m.

mike_s: pricing wise, how much more for q8 vs fp16 on Dedicated? ballpark?

elaine: q8 should be cheaper runtime but may need more inference memory if we keep KV cache in fp16. estimate: +10-20% infra cost. i'll confirm after scan.

infra-bot: scan complete. results: KV-cache shim detected, performance within SLO (p99 latency +4%), memory overhead +16%, no kernel fallback required. artifacts: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/scans/jb_84321/report.html

rajiv: good — no obvious blocking regressions. two caveats: 1) cold-start tokenization mismatch for a tiny subset of prompts (we have test case), 2) KMS integration needs per-deployment key provisioning (StratusX requires EKM).

alexa: legal-bot can you flag the KMS/EKM ask? enterprise needs EKM for keys.

legal-bot: added to security questionnaire. Q9: Do you support external key managers / EKM for Dedicated? Answer draft: "Yes — Dedicated can be configured with customer-managed keys via supported KMS providers; EKM requires ops approval and a short integration window."

mike_s: timeline for getting a signed quote and ops validation?

elaine: if no infra changes, ops validation 2-3 business days. pricing quote by EOD tomorrow once I confirm memory/cpu impact.

alexa: perfect. I'll loop in cathy and send a short summary + the scan link. thanks team :thumbsup: 

mike_s: can someone drop a minimal test prompt for the tokenization edge-case so we can show StratusX?

rajiv: dropping the failing prompt here:

```
<prompt> Summarize the following: "Curiosity-driven exploration" with nested quotes and emojis 😂 "end"</prompt>
```

rajiv: it reproduces a 2-token shift in ~0.2% of cases. I have a fix branch ready if needed.

alexa: ok assigned to rajiv for the patch, elaine for ops validation, mike_s for pricing quote. I'll update the thread after outreach to cathy.

mike_s: thx.

alexa: closing loop for now. will reopen if Cathy asks for more tests"
